body:
Helps the adventurers understand the children’s investigation and possible coven locations.

Recorded role and choices

Henry first insists that the children’s club is secret, even bluffing about what happens to adults who disclose it. In the later February 2026 meeting, he explains their fear of being eaten and points to a possible Whispers Coven location. The children’s proposed locations remain leads rather than confirmed discoveries. Henry’s frightened bravado does not make him a generic child label or an authoritative expert on all hags.
